set.body: PRD A-11 and the real-data ASC support boundary. Prove one permitted redistributable real EDF-derived ASC through portable import, Recording or BinocularRecording as appropriate, ObservedTimeline, and a downstream Scanpath. Preserve conversion provenance to the extent available; state unknown converter fields explicitly. Account for source lines, samples, events, messages, blocks and rejected/unknown records; bind the fixture and expected outputs to exact digests. Run the fixture on JVM and Scala.js and document the supported layout. This proves the named portable workflow, not every hardware/format cell or licensed EDF API equivalence. The broader dual-oracle, device-matrix and release-artifact obligations remain on the EyeLink reliability programme and its existing children.
